en.html:
“I am power”
Shooting Star Gang Member A"You saw also?"
Shooting Star Gang Member B"Haan, no doubt. The Kubo of Horigoe. Chachamaru Ashikaga!"
Shooting Star Gang Member A"Hardly any guards. One man, one woman."
Shooting Star Gang Member C"...Shall we do it?"
Shooting Star Gang Member B"Obviously! Such a chance comes and we let it go? Pagal hai kya!"
Shooting Star Gang Member C"But getting the equipment now—will there be time?"
Shooting Star Gang Member B"They're unarmed. One knife is enough."
Shooting Star Gang Member A"Ruk. Don't be reckless. These are Rokuhara people, remember."
Shooting Star Gang Member C"Then what's the plan?"
Shooting Star Gang Member A"We wait for Yazawa to return. Then we act."
Shooting Star Gang Member C"Yazawa? He's gone to get the equipment?"
Shooting Star Gang Member A"Don't worry. Not all the way to the hideout. He'll be back soon..."

ja.html:
〝我は力〟
流星団Ａ「お前も見たか？」
流星団Ｂ「ああ、間違いないな。 　堀越公方、足利茶々丸だ！」
流星団Ａ「護衛は少ない。 　男と女が一人ずつ」
流星団Ｃ「……やるか？」
流星団Ｂ「当たり前だ！ 　こんなチャンスを逃してどうする！」
流星団Ｃ「しかし、今から道具を調達していて間に合 うか？」
流星団Ｂ「奴らは武装していない。 　ナイフ一本で充分やれる」
流星団Ａ「待て、それは無謀だ。 　相手が六波羅だということを忘れるな」
流星団Ｃ「ならどうする」
流星団Ａ「矢沢が戻ってから仕掛ける」
流星団Ｃ「矢沢？ 　あいつ、道具を取りに行ってるのか？」
流星団Ａ「大丈夫、アジトまで行かせたわけじゃない。 　すぐに戻ってくる……」
